name: Release v1.0.5-Stable
body:
## Koma v1.0.5 - Changelogs

### ✨ New Features & UI Polish
- **Custom Library Header:** Redesigned the top of the Library UI with a bold, large header and an elegant total entries count below it.
- **Pill-Shaped Categories:** Category tabs in the Library have been completely revamped into sleek, pill-shaped chips with checkmark selection indicators.
- **Improved Content Density:** Changed the default portrait library grid size from 2 to 3 columns for a much better viewing experience out of the box.
- **Repo Finder Maintenance Mode:** Repositories in the Repo Finder can now be marked as under maintenance directly via JSON. When active, it displays a red "MAINTENANCE" badge and disables the installation button to prevent errors.

### 🛠 Under the Hood & Bug Fixes
- **Repo Finder Fix:** Resolved a 404 error causing the Repo Finder to crash by pointing the repository index URL to the newly structured endpoint (`udink.me/repos.json`).
- **Updates Carousel Localization:** Fixed an issue where the "Updates" and "See More" texts in the Library Carousel were hardcoded and failed to switch languages when changed in settings.
- **Automated APK Naming:** Configured the internal build system to automatically name generated APKs with the version and architecture type (e.g., `koma-1.0.5-64bit.apk`) for better clarity.
- **Documentation Migration:** Replaced all remaining external `mihon.app` help and documentation URLs with native `udink.me/koma` links.

### 📥 Which file should I download?

| File | For |
|------|-----|
| `koma-1.0.5-64bit.apk` | **Most modern Android phones (64-bit)** ✅ Recommended |
| `koma-1.0.5-32bit.apk` | Older Android phones (32-bit) |
| `koma-1.0.5-x86.apk` | Android Emulators on PC |
| `koma-1.0.5-x86_64.apk` | ChromeOS / 64-bit Emulators |

> **Note:** These APKs are natively signed and ready to install. No manual signing required!

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/UDIN-K/KOMA/compare/v1.0.4...v1.0.5

## Koma v1.0.4 - Changelogs

- **Inline Updates Calendar:** A compact calendar widget is now embedded in the Updates screen, showing upcoming releases at a glance.

### 🎨 UI & UX
- **Compact Calendar Layout:** Reduced calendar size with smaller fonts and tighter spacing so your updates list stays visible without excessive scrolling.
- **Navigation Bar Redesign:** Bottom navigation bar refined with cleaner styling and better visual balance for a more comfortable experience.
- **Help & Support Updated:** Help tab now directs to the official KOMA repository at udink.me/koma/.

name: Release v1.0.2-Stable
body:
## Koma v1.0.2 - Stability & Polish 🔧

A focused update to squash bugs and refine the reading experience!

### 🐛 Bug Fixes
- **Fix Overscroll Stretch Bug (Android 12+):** Disabled the system overscroll stretch effect that was causing items on the More screen to become completely untappable after scrolling.
- **Fix More Screen Navigation Clipping:** Resolved the floating navigation bar overlapping and clipping content at the bottom of the More screen (80dp padding fix).
- **Fix Scroll Interaction Issues:** Corrected touch target accuracy after scroll boundary interactions — taps now always register on the correct item.
- **Debug Build Google Services:** Added proper Google Services support for debug build variants to prevent crash on debug builds.

### ✨ Improvements
- **What's New Dialog:** The "What's New" button now appears in all build types (previously hidden in Debug builds).
- **ScrollbarLazyColumn Padding:** Improved `contentPadding` handling for proper scroll behavior with the floating navigation bar.
- **Updated Changelog:** Changelog now reflects the full KOMA release history with proper branding.
- **README & GitHub Presence:** Updated repository with proper badges, branding, and social preview.

body:
***

# Koma v1.0.1 - UI Improvements 🎉

Welcome to the very first release of **Koma**, your new premium manga, comic, and webtoon reader!

### ✨ What's New
* **Complete Rebrand & Redesign**: Transitioned from the legacy Tachiyomi/Mihon base into a fresh, standalone premium experience.
* **Modern "Floating Island" Navigation**: Swapped the old edge-to-edge bottom bar with a sleek, translucent floating pill that lets your library content glide beautifully underneath.
* **Premium Library Grid**: Replaced sharp UI elements with smooth rounded corners, spacious padding, and deep glassmorphism text-gradients for a high-end visual experience.
* **Refined Typography & Badges**: Perfected cover badges and text weights to ensure maximum readability and a clean, modern aesthetic. 
* **Midnight Deep Theme**: A brand new, sleek dark theme with vibrant cyan accents for comfortable reading.
* **Optimized Build**: Removed old legacy assets, fixed crash loops on missing icons, and streamlined the app repository.
* **Core Features**: Includes advanced library management, custom extensions support, automatic webtoon detection, and built-in tracking (MAL, AniList, etc).

### 📥 Which file should I download?
* **`app-standard-arm64-v8a-release.apk`**: For most modern Android phones (64-bit). *(Recommended)*
[app-standard-arm64-v8a-release.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27064025/app-standard-arm64-v8a-release.zip)

* **`app-standard-armeabi-v7a-release.apk`**: For older Android phones (32-bit).
[app-standard-armeabi-v7a-release.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27064030/app-standard-armeabi-v7a-release.zip)

* **`app-standard-x86...` / `x86_64`**: Only for Android Emulators on PC or ChromeOS devices.
[app-standard-x86_64-release.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27064049/app-standard-x86_64-release.zip)


*(Note: These APKs are now natively signed and ready to install. No manual signing required!)*
